ticket_legacy_archive_mapping_check.name: ticket_legacy_archive_mapping_check
ticket_legacy_archive_mapping_check.value: ("ticket_legacy_archive"."disposition" IN ('imported','merged') AND "ticket_legacy_archive"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ticket_legacy_archive"."disposition" IN ('quarantined','excluded') AND "ticket_legacy_archive"."ticket_id" IS NULL)

tickets_migration_origin_check.name: tickets_migration_origin_check
tickets_migration_origin_check.value: ("tickets"."data_origin"='legacy' AND "tickets"."migrated_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tickets"."data_origin"<>'legacy' AND "tickets"."migrated_at" IS NULL)

tickets_source_provenance_check.name: tickets_source_provenance_check
tickets_source_provenance_check.value: ("tickets"."source_endpoint" IS NULL AND "tickets"."source_hash" IS NULL AND "tickets"."first_source_seen_at" IS NULL AND "tickets"."data_origin"='legacy') OR ("tickets"."source_endpoint" IS NOT NULL AND "tickets"."source_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "tickets"."first_source_seen_at" IS NOT NULL)
